app/app.js.rule: Hard ceiling. Deployment capability policy remains extracted.

app/eve-archive-ops.js.rule: Archive mutation policy only. Archive rendering remains outside this operational module.

app/eve-study-lifecycle.js.rule: Study live/off publication policy only. This is a hard ceiling; future lifecycle cleanup should shrink it.

app/eve-participant-submit.js.rule: Participant submission validation/serialization/orchestration only; rendering remains injected.

app/eve-v56-polish.css.rule: Final interaction/readability layer only. Keep typography and editable-state polish here rather than expanding app.js.

server.js.rule: HTTP/static/relay composition only. Platform-service setup, buffering and state-store mechanics remain extracted.

lib/live_security.js.rule: Production readiness, security headers, public abuse throttling and deployment safety only.

app/eve-study-themes.js.rule: Theme registry, normalization and Study Settings theme-picker markup only.

app/eve-study-themes.css.rule: Participant/Preview theme styling only. Do not theme the researcher workspace here.

app/eve-setup.js.rule: Provider-neutral first-run state/checks only. Provider-specific full-cloud/Google presentation stays in deployment adapters.

cloudflare-relay/src/worker.mjs.rule: Zero-access Cloudflare relay transport only; no research analysis or researcher workspace logic.

app/eve-deployment.js.rule: Deployment/runtime adapter only: Apps Script compatibility plus full organisation-cloud setup/runtime seam.

google-workspace/Code.gs.rule: Google Workspace server runtime, Sheet launcher, drive.file backend and indexed encrypted-response transport.

google-workspace/Launcher.html.rule: Copied Google Sheet setup/deployment launcher only.

app/eve-capabilities.js.rule: Deployment capability registry, notices and capability-aware health only.

lib/runtime_config.js.rule: Expose only non-secret deployment/runtime facts to the browser.

lib/relay_response_index.js.rule: File-backed relay response indexing only; no HTTP or study policy.

app/cloud-storage.js.rule: Storage orchestration only; provider server logic stays in service modules.

lib/organisation_storage.js.rule: Authenticated organisation-owned encrypted file store only; no research decryption.

lib/state_store.js.rule: Postgres/file control-plane state abstraction, migration and advisory locking only.

lib/platform_services.js.rule: Compose server-side platform services and persistence dependencies only.
